messages:
Alex (Sales): Quick handoff — NewLeaf Enterprise closed-won. 200 seats, expected go-live in ~6w. Main ask: SSO (SAML) + HIPAA attestation before invoice finalization. Sales notes: lead time on security docs is why finance delayed.
Maria (CS): Thanks Alex. I'll own onboarding. Current plan: kickoff week 1, SAML test week 2, pilot w/ 5 power users week 3-4, full rollout wk6. Can you drop credentials for their IdP and contact at NewLeaf?
Alex (Sales): Contact: carla@newleaf.health and IT lead Sam Patel (sam.patel@newleaf.health). IdP metadata URL: https://idp.newleaf.internal/metadata.xml. Also attach signed BAA draft in this thread.
Alex (Sales): Attached BAA link: https://redwood-secure/files/BAA_NewLeaf_v1.pdf :lock: 
Maria (CS): Got it. Notes on risk: procurement won't release PO until BAA + SSO test pass. Flagging as "renewal risk" if we miss go-live target. @Priya (Eng) heads up — we may need eng support for SAML edge-case.
Priya (Eng): Thanks. Quick question: do they require IdP-initiated login or SP-initiated? Also any SCIM provisioning needed?
Alex (Sales): They want IdP-initiated + SCIM for user sync. SCIM endpoints will need token-based auth. Sample SCIM flow they use: POST /scim/v2/Users with bearer token.
Priya (Eng): Ok—I'll scope a small integration task. @Josh (Support) can you create a support ticket to track the SSO/SCIM work and link to this thread? We'll need a test tenant and logs.
Josh (Support): Opening ticket now: SUP-2026-4821. I'll include steps to reproduce, requested API tokens, and a checklist: 1) test IdP SSO, 2) SCIM create/update, 3) user_sync smoke tests, 4) HIPAA audit log export. Linking ticket: https://support.redwood/SUP-2026-4821
Maria (CS): I'll schedule the kickoff with NewLeaf for Mon 11am PST. Primary CS owner: Maria (me). Onboarding engineer: Priya. Support owner: Josh. Next steps: Alex drop BAA + IdP metadata (done), Maria to run kickoff invite (in calendar), Priya to estimate SCIM effort (EOD Thursday), Josh to open ticket (done). I'll update the account health score: currently Amber (onboarding blocked by SSO/BAA).
Priya (Eng): Estimating SCIM + SAML test ~2-3 dev-days including logs and test tenant. If SCIM tokens are non-standard might add extra day. I'll create a short PR checklist and post link when ready.
Alex (Sales): Thanks team. One more: capture product feedback — NewLeaf asked for bulk embedding export and per-route cost breakdowns in Console. Maria pls add to feedback tracker.
Maria (CS): Will add to feedback tracker entry: FB-2026-117. Will include priority and demo ask for Console team. :memo: 
OncallBot: Note: Deploy window Thurs 02:00-04:00 UTC. If SSO changes require infra deploy, coordinate with eng-release.
Josh (Support): Ticket SUP-2026-4821 updated with test tenant creds placeholder. Assigning to Priya for engineering-run. I'll monitor and escalate if blockers.
Maria (CS): Closing loop — I'll mark Sales handoff complete after kickoff. Opening a renewal watch: Review 30 days post-rollout. Any objections?
Alex (Sales): No objections. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
